shape.most_renamed_repo: an automated account renaming its repository roughly hourly to generated names (143 changes in 144 events); identity not recorded (no real user data in the repo)

consequences: renames are common enough for SCD2 to matter (the plan's 20% risk did not happen)
a version is an island of consecutive events with the same name: A -> B -> A is three versions
the dimension must be computed so that only the ~0.9% of multi-name ids pay the window function
